critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1240 lines — well past the 700-line modularization threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into routers: auth.py, bot.py (incl. presets), alerts.py, exchange_keys.py, users.py, market.py, public.py.
STRATEGY_PRESETS is a const dict — good. apply_preset uses bot_config.update() which is in-process mutation; the 15s _persist_runtime_state task picks it up correctly. Restart-hydration verified.

_evaluate_alerts is called inside background_tick every 2s — fine. Cooldown uses _alert_last_fired in-memory dict; if the server restarts, cooldown timer is reset so a rule could re-fire immediately on boot. Consider persisting last_fired_at (already stored on the rule doc) and reading it on tick startup to prevent post-restart alert storm.

/api/exchange-keys/{exchange}/test catches no exceptions around worker_client.get(...) — if the worker is up but returns malformed JSON the request will 500 instead of falling back to mock. Minor; mock-fallback path is the common case today.
AlertRuleUpdate.model_dump(exclude_none=True) is fine but means a client cannot explicitly unset notes/channels back to None — they would have to send an empty string / []. Acceptable for now.
/api/alerts/events excludes _id correctly via projection — good. limit clamped to 500 — good.

Bot Config 'Strategy Presets' card UI is excellent: visible color cues per profile (conservative=primary, balanced=plain, aggressive=destructive), descriptive subtitles. No applied-pill 'X applied' was visible after clicking (the buttons highlight but no transient toast); spec wanted a pill — minor cosmetic gap.
Alerts page renders 31 historic events neatly; TEST FIRE event for UI_TEST_RULE was injected and shown at top within ~1s — fast feedback loop. data-testids are complete and stable.
Viewer role enforcement is verified BOTH at sidebar nav level (hidden) AND at route guard level (/alerts → / redirect via App.js isAdmin && <Route>). Defense in depth ✔.
